detail: S9/S10 model_prob values in bets.csv are np.prod of leg probabilities (line_lab/strategies.py _add_parlays). Under dependence, the product is not a joint probability, so the joint-evidence gate (C01) is not satisfied and the combos are published unranked with skill columns blank.
title: Parlay probabilities are products of leg marginals; combos stay unranked

detail: S11 (season win-total futures) rows in bets.csv carry market_prob but no model_prob, so no proper score can be computed. 83 ledger rows; staking metrics only.
title: Futures strategy has no model probability; skill columns blank

detail: data/derived/bets.csv uses S1-S11 (line_lab definitions) while data/derived/gates_results.csv uses S01-S18 (pipeline definitions) with different meanings. This lab scores only the bets.csv family and labels it as such on every page; never score one ledger from the other.
title: Strategy-ID collision across builds (audit flag X01)

detail: All inputs derive from the pinned nflverse/nfldata commit a270278f3ac4e937295fe6a27814b3c4a2b62645 (checksummed in data/derived/summary.json). The NFL publishes no closing lines, prices or probability forecasts; every 'market' benchmark is therefore the pinned dataset's market, not an official league number.
title: Benchmarks are the repository's pinned third-party dataset, not official league data

detail: Side draws use numpy default_rng seed 20261119. A different seed draws a different path; the row exists as a luck anchor (C04), not as an estimate.
title: CONTROL random is one seeded realisation, not a distribution

detail: The multiplicity adjustment (BH q=0.10) is applied to the 8 p-values of the ranking benchmark (market) only. Coin and favourite benchmark p-values are published raw and labelled as outside the ranking family.
title: Ranking uses one benchmark family; supplementary benchmarks are shown but not FDR-controlled

detail: Outbound access is limited to GitHub/npm/PyPI, so no official NFL value was re-read or republished by this lab. The capture/ pipeline (GitHub runners) is the official-source channel; this lab consumes none of it.
title: nfl.com unreachable from this sandbox; no official league value republished

detail: Recomputing settlement from data/raw/closing_lines.csv (line, odds) joined to data/raw/games.csv (scores) disagrees with the outcome column of closing_lines.csv itself on 6 SPREAD, 8 TOTAL and 4 MONEYLINE rows (of 20208 with a recorded outcome). Moneyline ties recorded as 0.5 are pushes and are treated as such; the remaining rows flip the recorded winner of the bet. This lab settles control bets from the pinned scores and publishes the agreement rate; the affected rows are listed in skill_recheck/data/flags.json (L08.mismatch_rows). The line_lab ledger settles from scores too and is not affected.
title: Pinned closing-lines outcome column contradicts pinned scores on 18 rows

detail: data/raw/closing_lines.csv carries closing odds only for part of the window (moneylines throughout 2006-2018; spread/total odds only 2017-2018), so universe A is restricted to priced events and published as such. To give the favourite control full-window coverage, universe B prices every bet at the flat -110 fallback documented in research/methodology.md. Its ROI is therefore a standard-vig anchor, not a market-price outcome, and no de-vigged forecast exists (Brier columns blank).
title: Control universe B prices are 100% imputed at the documented -110 fallback

detail: S1-S11 were defined in line_lab's committed protocol before their evaluation window closed for those builds; this lab adds scoring rules (R1-R7) fixed before computing them, but the underlying strategies are not new pre-registrations. Full pre-registration (A10) remains open on the readiness register.
title: Pre-registration status of the ranked family is inherited, not new

detail: In the leaderboard block of data/derived/summary.json, every TOTAL strategy (S3, S7, S6) carries the identical brier_skill -0.019496..., every ATS strategy (S1, S4, S5, S8) carries -0.031634..., and the ML strategy S2 carries -0.038775... — the value is constant within market, so it is a market-level estimate, not a per-strategy one. This lab's per-strategy BSS with bounds supersedes it; the backtest ledger here quotes the published column verbatim and labels it accordingly.
title: summary.json leaderboard publishes market-level brier_skill under per-strategy labels

detail: skill_lab/metrics.py (merged via PR #115) defines settled() as outcome in {0, 1} and scores y = outcome. The per-bet ledger codes -1 = loss, 0 = push, +1 = win (line_lab/evaluation.py: wins = outcome > 0, losses = outcome < 0, pushes = 0; pnl settles -1 to the full stake and 0 to zero). The consequence: every losing bet (8,653 of 16,439 ledger rows) is excluded from scoring and every push (296) is relabeled as a loss, so the published Brier skill is computed on winning bets only — selection on the outcome. The published per-strategy numbers reproduce exactly under that filter (see the reconciliation table on index.html: recomputed BSS matches the published value to 10 decimal places for every strategy), which proves the mechanism. Recomputed on the full settled set (losses included, pushes properly excluded), 0 of 8 strategies beat the de-vigged market; every ranking bound is negative (this lab's leaderboard). Two secondary defects in the same file: (a) its bootstrap receives the full group including pushes and excluded rows while the point estimate uses the settled subset, so its CI is not an interval for its point; (b) its controls are computed from market_lab/data/results_feed.csv, whose own outcome coding differs from the ledger's, so the controls are not comparable to the strategy rows. The controls themselves are internally consistent. Request logged for the skill_lab owner: adopt the corrected filter or withdraw the 5-of-8 claim; nothing on this lab's pages overwrites their files.
title: PR #115's merged per-strategy leaderboard scores only winning bets; its 5-of-8 skill claim is an artifact
